findings.title: Missing agent-first bootstrap entrypoint
findings.claim: The server exposes 53 flat tools but no server instructions, prompts, resources, or deterministic bootstrap tool, so callers must manually orchestrate target, attach, runtime, context, capture, export, and cleanup state.

evidence.measurement: tools=53, toolsListBytes=21769, requiredFields=73, outputSchema=0, annotations=0, title=0

findings.impact: High tool-selection cost, repeated manual state management, brittle recovery, and poor first-use experience.
findings.recommendation: Add wxmp_doctor, wxmp_open, and wxmp_close; publish server instructions/prompts/resources; default to an agent toolset of 12-18 tools.

findings.title: Unknown WMPF envelopes lose their payload
findings.claim: The bridge records only seq and compressAlgo for an envelope before decoding three known categories; unknown category payload bytes, after, originalSize, length, and hash are discarded.

evidence.observation: 55 generated WARemoteDebug message constructors and 19 category constants

findings.impact: The project cannot build a versioned protocol corpus or learn from new runtime categories.
findings.recommendation: Persist bounded unknown-envelope metadata and payload artifacts with version, size, SHA-256, decoder state, and category histogram.

redaction.redaction_method: runtime payload values omitted; counts and paths only

findings.title: WMPF and CDP context identities are flattened
findings.claim: WMPF logical jscontextId and CDP Runtime.executionContextId are represented in a flat context map without explicit identity edges.

evidence.observation: contexts 1,3,4,5,6 all classified as appservice with the same route and href

findings.impact: Context selection is ambiguous and downstream scripts, requests, pages, and AppID cannot be reliably attributed.
findings.recommendation: Introduce a provenance-bearing context graph from process to WMPF context to CDP execution context to app/page role.

findings.title: Script breakpoint result ignores actualLocation
findings.claim: wxmp_set_breakpoint normalizes only result.locations, although Debugger.setBreakpoint returns actualLocation.

evidence.observation: live gate separately parses actualLocation to decide success

findings.impact: A bound breakpoint can be reported as boundLocations=0, misleading the Agent and acceptance consumers.
findings.recommendation: Normalize locations and actualLocation into one boundLocations list and test both CDP breakpoint methods.

findings.title: API inventory destructively drains hook records
findings.claim: wxmp_get_api_inventory(include_hooks=true) and wxmp_get_hooked_requests both call the same drain() function.
findings.impact: A read-only summary call can remove evidence required by the next detail call.
findings.recommendation: Use an append-only bounded ring buffer with cursor-based peek; make release explicit or defer it to stop.

findings.title: Replay changes request transport semantics
findings.claim: wxmp_replay_request always evaluates a fetch-based replay expression regardless of the original request source.
findings.impact: wx.request-specific options and runtime behavior are lost, so replay is not transport-faithful.
findings.recommendation: Record transport and transport-specific options; replay through the same transport by default and report semanticDowngrade when impossible.

findings.title: Capability scope is inconsistent across contexts
findings.claim: Trace and request-hook activation are tracked per context while Network is a single session boolean.
findings.impact: Enabling or disabling Network in one context can misrepresent capture state in another context.
findings.recommendation: Track domain activation per context and derive the session-level capability as an aggregate.

findings.title: WeChat domain snapshot is absent
findings.claim: The runtime probe returns mostly capability booleans and publicStatus omits target AppID; launch options, page stack, page data, storage, components, package topology, and cloud inventory are not first-class results.
findings.impact: The Agent must write ad-hoc Runtime.evaluate expressions before it can understand the current mini-program.
findings.recommendation: Add a provenance-bearing app/page/runtime snapshot returned by wxmp_open and wxmp_app_snapshot.

findings.title: Static index does not parse mini-program structure
findings.claim: Static index v1 extracts URLs, wx APIs, and navigation routes with regex but does not parse app.json, subpackages, plugins, components, permissions, or source relationships.
findings.impact: Static output cannot drive package selection or runtime-to-source correlation.
findings.recommendation: Build a versioned manifest-first index with source locations and an optional AST adapter.

findings.title: Default toolset contains duplicate and maintenance tools
findings.claim: wxmp_list_targets duplicates wxmp_detect_wmpf; wxmp_session_status duplicates wxmp_get_runtime_info; raw/Profile/proxy maintenance tools are exposed by default.
findings.impact: Tool choice becomes noisier and MCP context is spent on expert-only schemas.
findings.recommendation: Deduplicate and expose agent/expert toolsets, defaulting to the agent surface.

findings.title: Result and error contracts lack MCP-native recovery metadata
findings.claim: Success and errors are returned only as text JSON, with no outputSchema, structuredContent, retryable, nextActions, needsUserAction, or missingCapability fields.
findings.impact: Clients cannot validate outputs or reliably continue after lifecycle failures.
findings.recommendation: Define versioned success/error schemas and publish structuredContent plus recovery semantics.

findings.title: Cross-context script and request identifier collisions are not bounded
findings.claim: Scripts and requests are keyed only by scriptId/requestId although one bridge multiplexes multiple WMPF contexts; uniqueness across those contexts has not been demonstrated.
findings.impact: If identifiers are only context-local, later events can overwrite earlier records and misattribute source or traffic.
findings.recommendation: Run a dual-context collision experiment and, unless global uniqueness is proven, key records by contextId plus protocol ID.
